notes: A Catan-derived hex settlement game is Strategy's Board & Card Games preset, and the answers put the camera above a stylized tabletop with nobody standing on it, so stage B's second question answers no and the route carries SET alongside P0 — the board, pieces and table are still fully built, only traversal and jump-gap checks drop. board-grid is the shape and tile-grid the board itself; collectible-nodes carries the tiered resource hexes players expand toward and fight over with the robber. I took the answers' 5-hex board and read the tier legibility requirement as geometry rather than UI, so hex height and glow scale with output rate. Everything else in the spec — the tick loop, ledger, remote-event validation, HUD, win condition — is systems work with no layout surface, so none of it produced a pick.
